newsitem.title: USA: Sears unit buys last remaining NTW franchise.
newsitem.headline: Sears unit buys last remaining NTW franchise.

text.p: Sears Automotive Group, a division of Sears, Roebuck and Co, said Thursday it completed the purchase of the last remaining NTW franchise. Terms were not disclosed.
In the last year, Sears has bought five franchise operations, which accounted for 21 stores in six states. The company plans to continue to operate the stores as NTW stores.
"This was an important objective for the Sears Tire Group as we continue to grow our off-the-mall tire store operations," said Paul Baffico, president, of Sears Automotive Group in a statement.

NTW was formed in 1971 and operated as an independently owned company until 1987 when it was purchased by Western Auto Supply Co. Sears bought Western Auto in 1988. NTW continued to operate as a unit of Western Auto until December, 1995 when the Sears Tire Group was formed and NTW and Tire America were integrated with the Sears Auto Centers.
